app_meta_title: ZPL editor | Live label preview, compare & export
app_description: Edit and preview Zebra ZPL labels in your browser. Compare versions, understand commands, and export to PNG, PDF or ZPL. No account needed.
social_image_alt: ZPL editor. Write ZPL. See the label. Live preview, label comparison, and PNG, PDF or ZPL export.
render_rate_limited: Labelary's rate limit was reached. Try again in a moment.
empty_preview: Paste ZPL or base64 into the editor to see your label.
sync_zoom_hint: Zoom and scroll every open file’s preview together.
compare_add_panel_hint: Open another file to compare two labels
settings_hint: The label to render on, whatever ^PW or ^LL say.
use_zpl_size: Render at the size from ^PW and ^LL
invalid_size: Enter a size between 0.25 and 30 inches
explain_hint: Show what each line does in plain words. Hover any command to see what its values mean.
download_hint: Press Enter to download, or type a new name first.
download_zip_hint: {count} labels download together as a zip.
close_tab_hint: Close tab. The file stays saved. Delete key also closes a focused tab.
storage_unavailable: Browser storage is unavailable or full. Download your files before leaving.
open_file_limit: Up to {count} files can be open at once. Close a tab to open another; it stays saved.
delete_file_hint: This removes the file and its label settings from this browser. This can’t be undone.
rename_file_hint: Choose the name shown in your tabs and saved files.
no_open_files_hint: Your saved files are still in Files. Open one or create a new file.
empty_library_hint: Create a file to start writing ZPL. It will be saved in this browser.
